1. Purpose of This Service The ICSH Rishta Service (“the Service”) is provided to help individuals and families connect for the purpose of marriage in a respectful, confidential, and community-centred manner. ICSH provides introduction and communication support only and does not guarantee any match, marriage, or outcome.

2. Information You Provide By submitting your profile, you confirm that: All information provided is true, accurate, and complete to the best of your knowledge. You understand that ICSH relies on the information you submit and cannot accept responsibility for any false or misleading details provided by participants. You consent to the use of your information for the sole purpose of facilitating suitable marital introductions.

3. Confidentiality & Data Protection ICSH is committed to protecting your privacy. We are registered with the ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) and respect GDPR policy. Your information will be kept confidential and will not be shared publicly. Profile details will only be shared: With potential matches, With parents/guardians (where appropriate), or With ICSH volunteers responsible for managing matches. Your data will not be sold, published, or given to third-party organisations. You may request your data to be updated or permanently deleted at any time by contacting ICSH.

4. Contact Between Participants ICSH may facilitate initial contact between two parties only after mutual interest is confirmed . Once two individuals/families agree to proceed, all further communication is strictly between them . ICSH does not monitor, control, or take responsibility for conversations, meetings, or outcomes once contact has been exchanged. Participants should always communicate respectfully , in line with Islamic etiquette and safeguarding principles.

5. Conduct & Behaviour Expectations By using the Service, you agree to: Behave respectfully and honestly with all ICSH members and participants. Avoid inappropriate, offensive, or harassing behaviour in any communication. Immediately inform ICSH if you believe someone is: Misrepresenting themselves Acting inappropriately Engaging in misleading or harmful behaviour ICSH reserves the right to remove or restrict any member who acts in a way that is harmful, disrespectful, or unethical.

6. No Guarantees or Liability ICSH does not guarantee: A successful match Compatibility Marriage The accuracy of information provided by others ICSH and its volunteers are not responsible for: Any personal, emotional, or financial loss arising from the use of this Service Decisions made by participants or their families Any meetings or discussions that occur after introductions are exchanged Participants are encouraged to conduct their own due diligence , family discussions, and independent checks before making any decisions.

7. Parental/Guardian Involvement ICSH encourages appropriate involvement of families where suitable. If participants are under 21, ICSH may require parental or guardian consent before sharing contact details.

8. Opt-Out / Withdrawal You may withdraw your profile or request to stop receiving introductions at any time by contacting: 📧 events@icsh.org.uk All your stored information will be deleted on request.
9. Updates to These Terms ICSH reserves the right to update or amend these Terms & Conditions at any time. Any significant changes will be shared with participants.

10. Acceptance of Terms By submitting your profile or engaging in any communication through the ICSH Rishta Service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.
